parent_objective: audit M2134 controlled panel construction result after required branch synthesis
blocked_by: M2135 synthesis must complete before controlled panel result audit
supersedes: direct controller ranking from controlled panel units
direct comparison protocol design without panel audit

public_gates: M2136 must audit M2134 controlled panel completeness and guardrails
M2136 must decide whether comparison protocol design is admitted
M2136 must not rerun reset rollout measured execution or execute policy actions
M2136 must keep ranking paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not treat comparison-support smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits controlled panel artifact after branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: controlled panel result audit only; no controller ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2134 construction is incomplete
stop if panel source kinds duplicate
stop if broad aggregate rows enter direct panel units
stop if audit ranks profiles directly
fallback_plan: route to comparison protocol design if panel construction is sufficient
route to scenario redesign if panel construction is insufficient or too confounded
route to branch synthesis if new evidence contradicts M2135
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2135 continues branch and admits panel result audit

blocked_shortcuts: do not skip result audit before comparison protocol design
allowed_updates: M2136 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for comparison protocol design or scenario redesign
next_stage_criteria: panel and exclusion counts are summarized
supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2136 audits panel construction and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2136.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If panel support is not sufficient, record the negative result and route to synthesis or scenario redesign rather than ranking aggregates.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU conclusion, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: turns controlled panel artifact into a bounded next-route decision after synthesis
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit comparison protocol design but cannot make a paper verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2136 contradicts M2135 continuation decision without a new synthesis

hypothesis: M2134 controlled panel construction is sufficient to admit comparison protocol design, but not direct ranking or paper claims.
success_criteria: panel and exclusion counts are summarized
no reset rollout measured execution ranking paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 claim is made
failure_criteria: new reset or rollout is performed
ranking or paper-level claims are made

commands.name: audit

decision_rule: M2136 passes if it audits M2134 and selects a bounded next route without rerun or ranking.
